Multiple Trains Cancelled Across India Due to Delhi Traffic Congestion

Several Indian railway divisions have cancelled multiple trains due to traffic congestion in the Delhi area. The Jammu Railway Division cancelled four trains scheduled for October 10. The West Central Railway (WCR) cancelled five Delhi-bound express trains, citing traffic congestion. Separately, Eastern Railway cancelled two Rajdhani Express trains originating from Kolkata. The South Central Railway also announced cancellations for Nanded-Santragachi services as part of special train arrangements.
